text:
maya: Heads-up — starting a least-priv rolling remediation for infra-admin entitlements next week. Plan is a 2-week canary on service identities -> 1 week broader -> automated prune+rollback window. Need KMS grant mapping and audit log hooks. Any objections?

sam: sounds sensible. how are we picking canary targets? prefer svcaccts first, not humans.

liam: agree with svcaccts. exclude deployer and payments services from canary (high risk).

anita: i can run the grant-mapping job. q: do we revoke KMS:Decrypt immediately or tag grants and wait? revokes can be disruptive.

security-bot: playbook created: https://go/redwood/leastpriv-playbook — includes checklist and rollback commands. :white_check_mark:

maya: rollout steps i'm thinking: 1) snapshot current grants + owners, 2) simulate removals to detect missing perms, 3) owner outreach with approve/rollback links, 4) scheduled prune with 72h rollback window.

sam: `scripts/kms-grant-audit.py --snapshot` covers step1 across accounts. we need to run cross-account so we capture inter-account roles. @anita can you run Tue?

anita: yep i'll run Tue 03:00 UTC and post artifacts to the thread. plan: tag any grant we intend to remove with `lp-canary=true` for 7 days before actual revoke. that gives telemetry.

liam: good. can we add an auditlog filter to detect 403 spikes or elevated error rates from canary principals? tie it to incidentbot to auto-revert if threshold exceeded.

security-bot: alert created: `leastpriv-prune-failure` — triggers when >5 unique 403s/min for 5m from canary set. pager: oncall.

maya: owner outreach template draft: "We plan to remove admin entitlement from <principal> on <date>. Click Approve to keep, or Request Rollback to escalate. If you need help, reply with repro steps." will share the exact copy for review.

sam: also include the quick rollback command in the message: `redwood-admin grant add --principal <id> --role infra-admin` and link to docs for KMS key policy edits.

anita: note: several infra tasks rely on a KMS key policy that references `role/infra-admin`. i'll enumerate those keys and request exceptions where necessary before prune.

liam: schedule a quick post-mortem 1 week after prune to capture false positives and tune the simulation heuristics. if we see false positives, widen simulation or adjust detection.

maya: thanks team. no objections raised in thread — moving forward. i'll create the canary ticket, update timeline in #release-war-room, and file the owner outreach batch. ping here when snapshot artifacts are uploaded. :rocket:
